Today, we celebrate the 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐞𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭, 𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞, held at the EDSA Shrine, presided by Cardinal Pablo Virgilio S. David.

This solemn protest reminds us of Christ’s cruxification, much like our nation burdened by corruption and sufferings.

Yet in the midst of injustice, may we seek peace, truth, and integrity. May Christ, our King, move us to become true leaders for our nation. ✊🇵🇭
